content.text:
[News] Samsung Foundry Loss Reportedly Seen Shrinking 42% YoY in 2026 as HBM4 Base-Die 4nm Demand Rises: Summarizes Digital Today’s account: HBM4 revenue expected to more than triple QoQ in Q3 and exceed 60% of HBM revenue in H2; Kiwoom’s combined Foundry/System LSI loss estimate is KRW 777 billion for Q3 and KRW 3.92 trillion for 2026. It also says memory-related demand alone has not filled capacity and external advanced-node orders matter for further improvement. (time=2026-09-30T04:00:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Samsung Ships Industry-First Commercial HBM4 With Ultimate Performance for AI Computing: Samsung announced HBM4 mass production and commercial shipments, describing a combination of 1c DRAM and a 4nm logic base die. It also forecast 2026 HBM sales above three times 2025 sales. (time=2026-02-12; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
